title: Woman in Floral Dress by Palm Tree, 1940s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A black-and-white snapshot from the early 1940s depicting a smiling woman standing outside residential bungalows framed by a tall palm tree. She is wearing a floral patterned dress paired with a dark overcoat and necklace, exemplifying everyday wartime era fashion. The setting suggests a warm climate location in suburban America such as California or Florida.
